text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, anemia with low erythrocytes but high hematocrit, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, monocytosis, basophilia, mild hypoglycemia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, and INR. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and a risk of coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
